content: dagre (original, unmaintained since 2022) vs @dagrejs/dagre (maintained fork, v3.0.0, verified npm) vs elkjs (v0.12.0, actively updated as of 2026-07-17). Dagre is a simple drop-in tree/DAG layout, fast, minimal config, supports LR direction natively. elkjs is a ported Java engine, far more configurable but asynchronous and complex, recommended only when dagre's layout quality is insufficient.
